card: Updates the release notes template upgrade instructions to direct Linux users to copy both bin/ and libexec/ when updating Bitcoin Core. Following the existing upgrade guidance leaves multiprocess helper binaries stale when using the wrapper executable added in #31375. The change resolves issue #36431 with a one-line documentation update.
evidence: Commit 2870608661 and PR description: "Since #31375, Linux installs ship a bitcoin wrapper in bin/ that dispatches to multiprocess binaries in libexec/. Copying only bitcoind/bitcoin-qt leaves those stale. Tell users to copy over bin/ and libexec/ instead."
Fixes open issue #36431: "doc: \"How to Upgrade\" release notes section is outdated since the `bitcoin` wrapper executable"
problem: Following the existing upgrade guidance leaves multiprocess helper binaries in `libexec/` outdated on Linux systems, leading to stale binaries when users invoke the `bitcoin` wrapper executable introduced in #31375.

risk.why: This is a one-line documentation change in a release notes template that has no impact on runtime code or node behavior.

summary: Updates the "How to Upgrade" section of the release notes template for Linux installations. It instructs users to copy over `bin/` and `libexec/` rather than individual `bitcoind`/`bitcoin-qt` binaries.
